quality_gate: singles only: greeks_ok=false if, outside regular hours only, |spot-close|/close > 2.5% (pre-market/after-hours repricing), or the median |call IV - put IV| over every strike within +-5% of spot having both legs with IV, across all non-expired expiries, exceeds 15 pts.
